description: This Java class 'MainResourceHandler' manages resources specified in XML configuration files within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods for loading resource data, retrieving metadata, and comparing resource handler instances, primarily focusing on XML resource handling.

classes.name: MainResourceHandler
classes.description: A final class implementing ResourceHandler interface, managing resource loading and metadata for XML specified resources within OFBiz framework.

methods.name: MainResourceHandler(String xmlFilename, Element element)
methods.description: Constructor initializing handler with XML filename and configuration element, extracting loader and location attributes.

methods.name: MainResourceHandler(String xmlFilename, String loaderName, String location)
methods.description: Constructor initializing handler with explicit loader name and location alongside filename.

methods.name: getLoaderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the loader associated with this resource handler.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location string associated with this resource handler.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Reads and returns the XML Document from the resource, throws exception on failure.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Provides an InputStream to the resource data, throws exception on failure.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Retrieves the URL of the resource, throws exception on failure.

methods.name: isFileResource
methods.description: Determines if the resource is a file-based resource.

methods.name: getFullLocation
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full file/location path.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another MainResourceHandler based on loader, filename, and location.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on filename, loader, and location.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the resource handler's main attributes.
